speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: How shall heart and speech hymn difference-gone form?
premises: Thus in such forms, giver, varied Your form shines — in own-portion this world, difference gone, of the Lord.
May heart to praise that same, and outer-speech-instrument songs, mine constantly, unabandoned-rush.
inference: Difference-gone form shines; heart-and-speech vowed unabandoned.
